profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Vail Systems
profile.summary: Planning and developing software while mentoring and leading teams of developers for over ten years primarily while working on the FreeClimb API team at Vail Systems, Inc.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Technical lead for two teams of developers each responsible for large sections of an API comprised of over one hundred services, libraries, and tools. Engaging in regular coding while working closely with business, product, project management, and members of the dev teams to plan and execute features for the platform as well as mentoring junior developers.

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description: Developing virtual reality applications in C++ using the openscenegraph tool set.

company.name: UIC Virtual Reality Undergraduate Projects Lab

positions.title: Tech Developer and Analyst Intern
positions.description: Worked on proprietary finance and trading software used in the bank written in Python.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Back end web development using PHP: specifically working with the CodeIgniter (http://ellislab.com/codeigniter) framework.
• Working with Camel and Drools in Java
• Working with MongoDB and MySQL

positions.title: NWS Computer Specialist I
positions.description:
• Monitor school computer labs
• Troubleshoot minor issues with lab computers, printers, other equipment
• Provide costumer support related to the labs and university accounts

company.name: University of Illinois at Chicago Academic Computing and Communications Center

positions.title: Backend Web Development Intern
positions.description:
Learn about, use, and create java web services.
Learn about and setup a Continuous Integration environment with Bamboo, Maven, Archiva, and SVN.

positions.title: I.T. Consultant
positions.description: General upkeep of office technology (computers, printers, routers, etc.). Creating menus, signs, and other displays.

positions.title: Crew Member/Shop Foreman
positions.description:
Build sets, run lights, sound, rigging for various performances.
From 2010 – 2011, I was promoted to be one of four scene shop foremen. Oversaw the day to day activities of the crew.
